summary: Haleon plc filed a Form 6-K reporting daily purchases under its ongoing share buyback programme announced on 12 March 2026. On 8 June 2026 it bought 565,285 ordinary shares at a VWAP of 331.9552 pence, all for cancellation. No other trades occurred 9–12 June. Post-settlement, registered capital stands at 8,842,187,061 shares (12,025,084 in treasury; 8,830,161,977 with voting rights). The buyback reduces share count over time, enhancing EPS. No premium, tender, or special offer—routine open-market purchases under a disclosed programme. Watch for pace of future buybacks and potential programme extension or completion announcements.
